core_obligations: Degree zero: the first assertion follows directly from the definitions of the local cohomology of principal opens and of the colimit in question (proof line 443)

Colimit reduction: since the functors in question commute with filtered colimits, the proof reduces the second assertion to the case where the module is annihilated by one element f of the multiplicative set (proof lines 444-446)

Degree one: in that case the local cohomology of every principal open V(ff') with f' in the multiplicative set vanishes, by the author lemma whose statement is included as a context span, so the colimit is zero (proof lines 446-448)
proof_roadmap: 第一式 (colim_{f∈S} H^0_{V(f)}(M) = M) 直接由定义得到。
对 H^1：RΓ_{V(f)} 与 H^1_{V(f)} 与 colim 交换，故可设 M 被某 f ∈ S 零化；此时对一切 f' ∈ S 有 H^1_{V(ff')}(M) = 0（用 lemma-already-torsion），故该 colim 为 0。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement computes the filtered colimit of the local cohomology of the principal opens determined by a multiplicative set: the degree zero parts recover the module when the module is localised to zero, and the degree one parts vanish (author lemma at source lines 434-440, label lemma-multiplicative). The proof (source lines 442-449) disposes of degree zero from the definitions, then uses commutation of the two functors with filtered colimits to reduce the degree one assertion to the case of a module annihilated by a single element of the multiplicative set, where the vanishing of the chapter on torsion modules applies. The colimit reduction and the appeal to the torsion vanishing are the content. H2.
